MECA.TITLE: SRS Side Airbag & SRS Curtain Shield Airbag System Operation

ITEM.PTXT: The SRS side airbags operate when the cabin body receives a strong impact from the side of the vehicle and the side airbag sensor and airbag sensor (computer) detect an impact above a certain level. The SRS curtain shield airbags operate when the cabin body receives a strong impact from the side of the vehicle and the side airbag sensor, rear airbag sensor and airbag sensor (computer) detect an impact above a certain level.
